class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackOpus
class.brief_description: Decodes queued Opus packets for playback.
class.description: The playback object returned by AudioStreamOpus through AudioStreamPlayer. Each instance owns one Opus episode, including its decoder, PCM ring and Speex output resampler.

method.name: available_space_frames
method.description: Returns unused capacity in decoded audio frames.

method.name: get_chunk_max
method.description: Returns the recent decoded peak magnitude.

method.name: get_decode_errors
method.description: Returns the number of Opus packets which failed to decode since playback started.

method.name: get_last_decode_error
method.description: Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] after a successful decode, otherwise the latest negative libopus error code.

method.name: get_overflow_frames
method.description: Returns the number of decoded frames dropped because the playback ring was full since playback started.

method.name: get_skips
method.description: Compatibility alias returning [method get_underflow_frames], or [method get_overflow_frames] when [param overflow] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: get_underflow_frames
method.description: Returns the number of output silence frames emitted because an active episode's decoded queue was empty.

method.name: finish_episode
method.description: Marks this episode's input as complete. The playback drains its PCM and resampler state, then stops itself. Returns the absolute decoded write position, or [code]-1[/code] if the episode was not receiving.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Provisions this playback for one episode after AudioStreamPlayer.play(). [param start_delay] schedules its first audible audio relative to initialization. If no footer arrives, an empty episode stops after [param stale_timeout] seconds without a packet.

method.name: push_opus_packet
method.description: Decodes one packet from [param begin], optionally using forward error correction. Returns the decoded frame count, or a negative libopus error code. Decoded frames which do not fit in the playback ring are counted by [method get_overflow_frames]. Call this from one producer thread only.

method.name: queue_length_frames
method.description: Returns the number of decoded frames waiting for playback.

method.name: set_sinewave_frames
method.description: Replaces decoded audio with a test sine wave for the given frames.
